info.title: Unwatched API
info.description:
REST API for unwatched.click: subtitles, translated transcripts, article-style summaries and still frames for any YouTube video.

Authentication: every operation except GET /openapi.json requires a per-user API key (`unw_sk_...`, mint one at https://unwatched.click/en/developer/keys) sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or in the `x-api-key` header.

Credits: billable operations debit a prepaid balance — 1 credit = $0.01. Each operation's description lists its price from the live catalog; cache hits are free, and every billable response carries `usage { creditsCharged, creditsRemaining }`. GET /credits reports the balance.

Async jobs: POST /summaries and POST /transcripts/translate answer 202 with a job (status "queued" or "running") and a Location header pointing at GET /jobs/{id}. Poll that URL about every 5 seconds (the responses also send Retry-After) until status is "succeeded" — the payload is in `result` — or "failed", with the reason in `error` and the credit hold refunded. A POST satisfied from cache answers 200 with the finished job in the same shape.

Human-readable docs: https://unwatched.click/en/api-docs

post.description: Fetches one subtitle track — segments carry `{ start, end, text }` so spans can be cited — plus the video's metadata and the full track list. Pass lang to pick a language, or omit it to take the best available track (detectedLang then reports the choice). Costs 1 credit when the transcript is not stored yet; stored transcripts are free.

post.description: Translates a stored transcript into targetLang. The transcript must already be in the store — POST /subtitles first, otherwise this fails with TRANSCRIPT_NOT_FOUND. Answers 202 with a job while it runs, or 200 with a finished job when a stored translation (or sourceLang === targetLang) satisfies the request. The running job costs 5 credits per hour of video (minimum 1 credit); cache hits are free.

200.description: Done immediately — a cached translation satisfied the request; the job is already succeeded.

202.description: Accepted — the job is queued or running. Poll the Location URL every 5 seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before polling the job again (5).

get.description: The machine-readable contract of /api/v1 — the document you are reading. Public: no API key, no rate limit, cached for 5 minutes.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document describing this API.

INVALID_REQUEST.description: The request body or query is invalid: bad types, missing required fields, an unknown video id format. Fix the input and retry; the message names the offending field.

UNAUTHORIZED.description: No API key was sent. Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" or "x-api-key".

INVALID_API_KEY.description: The key is not an unw_sk_ key, or it is unknown, revoked or expired. Create a new key at https://unwatched.click/en/developer/keys.

FORBIDDEN.description: The key is valid but your account is not allowed to perform this operation. Do not retry with the same account.

INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.description: Your credit balance is too low for this operation. Top up credits on the site, or pick a cheaper operation (e.g. subtitles instead of a summary).

NOT_FOUND.description: No such endpoint, or the referenced record does not exist. Check the path and ids against the API docs.

TRANSCRIPT_NOT_FOUND.description: No stored transcript for this video in the source language. Fetch subtitles first (POST /subtitles), then retry the translation.

NO_SUBTITLES.description: The video has no usable subtitle track, or the requested language is not among them. List tracks (GET /videos/:id/tracks) and pick an available language, or try another video.

VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE.description: The video cannot be fetched from any route we have: it is private, removed, or region-blocked everywhere we can reach. Do not retry the same video.

TRANSCRIPT_EMPTY.description: The video has a subtitle track for the requested language, but it parsed to no usable text (empty or malformed captions). Try another language from GET /videos/:id/tracks.

UNPROCESSABLE.description: The video exists but cannot be processed: private, region-blocked, empty transcript, and similar. The request was fine — nothing to fix; try a different video.

MEMBERS_ONLY.description: The video is only available to channel members or buyers, so its subtitles cannot be fetched.

RATE_LIMITED.description: Too many requests for this key in the current window. Slow down and retry after the window resets; use retryAfterSeconds when present.

SERVICE_BUSY.description: Extraction capacity is saturated. Retry the same request after retryAfterSeconds; repeated billable operations are idempotent within a UTC day and will not double-charge.

EXTRACTION_FAILED.description: Fetching data from YouTube (subtitles, metadata, frames) failed. Retry later; if it keeps failing, the video may be unavailable from every region we can reach.

GENERATION_FAILED.description: The AI step (summary or translation) failed after the transcript was available. Retry; a later successful run is billed normally, cached results are free.

INTERNAL_ERROR.description: Unexpected server error. Retry once after a short delay; if it repeats, report it — the details are in our server logs, not in the response.

JOB_NOT_FOUND.description: No job exists with this id, or it belongs to another account. Use the id returned by the create call.

JOB_INTERRUPTED.description: The server restarted mid-job; credits were refunded. Retry the same request.

TOO_MANY_JOBS.description: At most 3 jobs may be queued or running per account; wait for one to finish (poll GET /jobs/{id}) then retry.
